rationale: C terminus has the full GPI signal architecture: small residue at omega (Ser647 window), small residue at omega+2, polar spacer, and a 14-residue uncharged hydrophobic tail (mean KD 2.91) ending exactly at the C terminus. Score 7.5 is the top tier of the 5,130-protein S. pombe proteome and the architecture is conserved in two orthologs. Parent term chosen because the specific membrane cannot be determined

Would require the omega-minus dibasic rule, which fails to separate plasma-membrane from cell-wall GPI proteins in a fate-annotated panel (p = 0.439) and has been experimentally contradicted (PMID 10564469, PMID 24930114). Adg2 has 0 K/R in the omega-4..omega+2 window and its orthologs have 1 and 2, so the feature is not even conserved

If retained, it should be flagged as tagging-dependent and must not displace an anchored-component CC
A functional GPI signal predicts retention at the cell surface, not release. Adding this would contradict the anchored-component call
